reviews.title: Very good if you want something simple
reviews.text: I just downloaded this app today and have already used it a ton. I am an freshman in high school who really struggles with procrastination, and this helped a bunch! I sat down and worked for 25 min straight and then it gave me a five minute break, which I spent on my phone, then it continued. I would totally recommend for anyone who needs something really simple to help them focus (plus its visually aesthetic). The only reason I gave it 4 instead of 5 stars is because you have to upgrade to pro to have the timer run in the background of other apps. But, so far I haven’t gotten any adds for subscribing to pro (we all know how annoying those are). So, my opinion, if your a procrastinator and just need something simple and effective, get this! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
